Heat Fitness, Borrowmeadow Road, Stirling

Walking inis the hardest part.

Hi, welcome to Heat. I'm Helen. I've worked here since the studio opened, and it's my absolute pleasure to be running it now. I want this to be a space with something for everybody, from super slow, on-the-floor yoga to hot classes and strength sessions in the gym. You only ever do what you can manage, and nobody's going to force anything on you.

Already one of us? Your Hot 26 & 2, Fierce Grace and Yin are going nowhere. Everything I'm doing here is for you, so tell me what you want and I'll do my best to make it happen. See you on the mat!

Helen x
